Independent re-check by the QA agent for hunter expire76.

VERDICT pass -- the check that recorded this defect now passes, under the definition PINNED for this row. That pin was written by us rather than taken from the failing run, so this is not automatically the identical test; our reason is below, judge it.

WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the check function's parsed syntax tree. It changes when the check's logic changes and not when its comments or formatting do. It is the pinned definition, which is not necessarily the one recorded at the failure. Why this row carries a pin, in our own words: Report #80 documents the original failure: four order surfaces named the paper/live control three different ways and one had no field at all. Cymetica put `paper` on all four on 2026-09-08 and documented the remaining default differences per field. The check demanded one field AND one default, which was the shape of our request rather than of the contract -- the CLOB has no paper book and cannot default to paper, it refuses instead -- so it was narrowed to the property that protects a caller: one control name on every surface. The clause about the control not being honoured moved to its own check and its own row, because #80 was not filed about that. Pinning to the fingerprint this run observed.
